_README: Interface-dispatch fixture gauging the LSP/SCIP resolver tier. Checkout.run() calls processor.process() where processor is a PaymentProcessor interface with two impls — heuristics fan out to BOTH (wrong). symbol_index.json (what a SCIP/DI-aware indexer emits) resolves it to StripeProcessor only. Authored from source.
_di_resolution_note: LSP tier: only an authoritative index can resolve interface/polymorphic dispatch — type heuristics cannot tell which impl a PaymentProcessor reference binds to. With symbol_index.json present, di_resolution=1.0 and the call resolves to StripeProcessor at confidence 1.0 (resolved_by=index). Without it, heuristics fan out to both impls.
